name: github-issue-intake
description: Resolve a GitHub issue number or URL, fetch issue and comment context via gh, and emit a canonical issue brief. Use when starting issue-driven implementation planning. Ask when the repository or issue reference is ambiguous.

inputs.name: issue-reference
inputs.description: Issue number or full GitHub issue URL.

inputs.name: repository
inputs.description: Optional target repository as owner/name when not inferable.

inputs.name: user-clarifications
inputs.description: Optional user answers from prior clarification loops.

outputs.name: issue-brief
outputs.description: Canonical issue context for downstream planning agents.
